answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 7277 Country: United States of America Title: I saw a dream where I am in my local mosque and there are women in the prayer room mixed with men, and everyone is praying to the opposite direction of Kiblah. I am asking the president of the mosque to do something about this and we are both crying. Our masjid has issues here in the US such as Imam not having a proper beard which upsets me. Can you please interpret this dream? Question: Asalaamualaikum, I saw a dream where I am in my local mosque and there are women in the prayer room mixed with men, and everyone is praying to the opposite direction of Kiblah. I am asking the president of the mosque to do something about this and we are both crying. Our masjid has issues here in the US such as Imam not having a proper beard which upsets me. Can you please interpret this dream? Answer ID: 7277 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1820/1456=H/1429) It indicates that in religious matters, instead of intending the pleasure of Allah, you have included your carnal desires as well. May Allah protect all of us from the low morals! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
